title: A Universality Theorem for the Quantum Thermodynamics of Near-Extremal Black Holes
summary: We prove that the one-loop contribution from tensor modes to the thermodynamic entropy of near-extremal black holes is universal. Our proof applies to asymptotically flat, Anti-de-Sitter and de-Sitter black holes; it also covers spherical, axial and planar symmetries. We consider black hole configurations with and without matter sectors and explicitly discuss Abelian gauge fields and neutral scalar fields with arbitrary potential.
